svg.text: FLOOD FILL · EVERY CELL LABELLED WITH ITS DISTANCE TO THE GOAL

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The goal is 0. Each cell is one more than its cheapest open neighbour. Drive downhill

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: and you are on a shortest path — no search, just a comparison at every cell.
